g.text: Local recovery, measured completion and the cost of acting

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203343

g.text: A causal control-path schematic beside measured confirmation traces; no new model fitting or physical-car qualification.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #bc4c5e

g.text: 4 s development stopped: Map +5.505 pp; JEPA +4.748 pp. Its confirmation cases were not run.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Timing uses actual history-to-forecast issue work; startup/loading is separate. The shared 500 ms scheduling/other-work delay remains an assumption. Admission/scoring CPU is not separately scheduled.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Offline replays use original paid schedules and prove deterministic trace replay, not freshly measured deadlines. Fresh repetitions measure timing sensitivity without extra independent sites.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Native control consumes current pilots and completed, heard, capture-age-limited local scans. Model, sensing and handover effects form a controller package. Shared procedural CAD, conditional 60 s warm history and finite trials do not establish hardware safety or indefinite reliability.
